description: Today, Mar. 3, Gov. Mike Braun signed an executive order extending bereavement and parental leave for state employees. State Rep. Maureen Bauer (D-South Bend) released the following statement: “Today, I’m encouraged to see that Gov. Braun has signed Executive Order (EO) 25-34, which establishes new paid leave policies for state employees who experience childbirth or stillbirth. Under this EO, eligible employed women will receive six weeks of paid childbirth recovery leave, or up to eight weeks
paid_for_by: Authorized by Maureen Bauer for State Representative P
title: Bauer comments on Gov. Braun’s Executive Order extending parental leave
